title: Rebound, Outlet and Go
description: Rebound with a strong chin-tuck landing, pivot away from pressure, outlet to the sideline and fill the lanes for a three-player fast break.

content.objective: Turn a defensive rebound into an immediate outlet pass and a controlled three-player fast break with wide lanes.
content.setup: A rebounder stands on the block with a defender beside them. A coach shoots and the group rebounds. A teammate waits on the sideline as the outlet and a third player fills the far lane.
instructions: The coach shoots. The rebounder secures the ball with two hands, chin tucked and elbows out.
Pivot to the outside away from the defender and look for the outlet on the sideline.
Outlet pass to the sideline player, who catches on the move and dribbles to the middle of the court.
The rebounder fills the lane on one side and the third player fills the opposite lane.
Finish the fast break at the far basket; the trio stays to rebound the next attempt.
coachingPoints: Secure the rebound first; a fast break starts only after you own the ball.
Pivot away from pressure and keep the ball high and protected.
The outlet catches on the move and gets the ball to the middle quickly.
Fill the lanes wide: at least four metres from the ball handler.
commonMistakes: Rushing the outlet before the ball is secured.
Outlet player waiting at the sideline instead of moving to the ball.
Lane runners crowding the ball handler.
content.safety: Coach shoots only from the free-throw line; rebounders keep elbows below shoulder height on contact.
progressions: Add a defender who pressures the rebounder and a second who challenges the outlet.
regressions: Coach tosses the ball off the backboard for an easier rebound.
variations: Finish with a 3-on-2 attack against two defenders.
